description: This file defines the Standardize class within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library. It provides a method to normalize a value based on mean and standard deviation, supporting array inputs and handling errors.

classes.name: Standardize
classes.description: Provides a method to standardize values, supporting array inputs and error handling, within the statistical calculation namespace.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Calculates a standardized value from a distribution given the value, mean, and standard deviation. Supports array inputs and returns errors as strings.
